details.name: Improvement: root-cause share
details.message: Fixing causes: 47% of the 344 cards finished this week fixed a cause or added a system, the rest fixed one more case of a repeat problem (last week 55%). 31 problems keep coming back; 10 have a card to fix the cause, 21 more get one over the next days. 4 fixes claimed to stop a repeat, and it came back anyway. An independent check of 8 fixes from this week, reading only the code, found 6 of 8 fixed the cause.
